notes.title: Get your own unique achievement.
notes.content:
[b]Request to get your own unique achievement.[/b]
[olist]
[*] Request via email (Support@team-holst.com).
[*] You must provide information with a (name, description and a PNG image of 512x512) to create the achievement.
[*] You will receive an email when your achievement is created.
[*] You will get your achievement by entering the game.
[/olist]
